column1: # Tracked files left out of the tree digest on purpose.  One row per
# decision: a path pattern (* stays within one path segment), a check,
# and the reason.  The check is an extended regular expression that
# test/digest-reach-is-decided.mjs runs with git grep over test,
# run-tests.sh, rt, bin, tools, src and lib; it must match no code line.
# When one does, something has started reading the file and the row is
# red -- an exemption expires by itself instead of by someone noticing.
# Its blind spot is a name computed at run time (read.input was found
# that way); the reason column says what the check cannot see.
